03 · KI KOT JONG PHI KI SAH BAD PHI
Ki kot jong phi ki sah ha ka dukan jong phi.
Ki jingdie, ki party bad ka kot sngi la thoh ha ka device ha ka kaunta jong phi — kam ha ka server ba phi ai ka jingbai.
Ha ka device jong phi
Man ka jingdie, ka jingsiew bad u docket la pynsah ha ka computer lane tablet ba phi don.
Ym donkam account bad ngi
Pynbeit ia ka bad sdang. Ym donkam sign-up, ym donkam card.
Ki kopi ba phi buh
Pynsah ia ka kopi backup haba phi kwah. Ka dei ka file, bad ka dei jong phi.
Ki kaunta bad ki tablet kiba bujli ki iasoh ha ka Wi-Fi jong phi hi — khlem internet ha pdeng.

05 · KA DOR
Laitluid junom ha ki device jong phi.
Ym don dor na man ka jaka shong, u nongpyndonkam, ka miej bam, u nongniah kali, ka parsel lane ka device ha ka jaka. Kam dei ka jingpyrshang.
